messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-2026-0412 fired for inference-eu-embeddings (5xx spike) — triggered by 5xx-rate > 2% over 3m. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2026-0412, /alerts/embeddings-5xx
Nora: Acked. I'm the on-call SRE — taking first look. @Jordan FYI, can you shadow?
Jordan: on it, joining bridge. What's the customer impact?
Maya: I see high 5xx from eu-embed-worker-03 in logs. Looks like Redis timeouts followed by internal 502 in the embed pipeline. Sample log: ``[2026-03-14T21:02:11Z] worker=eu-03 ERR kvmiss: redis timeout after 500ms; downstream POST /v1/embeddings 502``
Nora: Throttling rules kicked in? Checking autoscaler and Redis metrics now. Running quick check: ``kubectl get pods -n inference | grep eu-embed``
Sam: Customer impact: 12 customers with >1% failed requests in last 5m, largest is acme-corp (10% failure on embeddings). They have a live job.
Jordan: Good to know. For mitigation, can we route embeddings traffic to us-east fallback pool? Ops runbook suggests immediate fallback if eu < 90% healthy.
Nora: Tentative plan: 1) Set routing override to fallback model/pool 2) Scale up eu-embed workers while we debug 3) Notify affected customers with ETA. I'm going to apply routing override now.
Nora: Applied temporary routing override: ``POST /internal/route-override {"route":"embeddings","pool":"us-east-fallback","expires":"+15m"}`` — response `200 OK`
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: routing-override accepted, hash=9f3c. Active for 15m. Telemetry will start showing shifted traffic in ~30s.
Maya: After override, 5xx rates dropped from 3.2% -> 0.4% in 45s. Looks promising. Still seeing Redis errors on eu-03, probably degraded instance.
Jordan: Agree we should isolate eu-03 and cordon it: ``kubectl cordon eu-embed-03 && kubectl drain eu-embed-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``
Nora: Draining eu-03 now. Also bumping replica count for eu-embed deployment by +2: ``kubectl scale deploy eu-embed --replicas=7``
Sam: I'll open a quick customer note in the status page: "Performance degradation for embeddings in EU region. Traffic routed to fallback pool. We are investigating; expected resolution within 30 minutes." Will ping support with customer list.
Maya: Running `redis-cli --rtt` on redis-eu-1 shows p95 latency 800ms; likely network flaps between redis and pods. Raising a ticket with infra network team.
Jordan: Logging this as action items in the incident: 1) routing override — done 2) drain eu-03 — in progress 3) scale replicas — done 4) infra network ticket — created (TKT-1829)
Nora: Handing off monitoring/bridge to Jordan for the next 20m while I run deeper post-mortem steps (heap dumps, core collection). If anything spikes, @Jordan escalate to me.
Jordan: Taking bridge and monitoring. I'll post periodic pings every 5m.
Jordan: (5m) 21:10Z — 5xx at 0.3%, routing still active, us-east handling ~27% of embedding requests.
Jordan: (10m) 21:15Z — eu worker pool stable, redis p95 improved to 420ms after infra team applied BGP smoothing. Considering removing routing override in 10m if stability holds.
Nora: I collected profiler + heap from eu-03 before drain. Uploading to /artifacts/incidents/INC-2026-0412/profiles.tgz and attaching to the ticket.
Maya: infra team comment on TKT-1829: "Detected flapping link between eu-switch-2 and redis-eu-1, fixed by rate-limiter adjustment. Monitoring for 10m."
Jordan: (20m) 21:25Z — 5xx under 0.2% and trending down. I'm removing routing override now: ``POST /internal/route-override/delete 9f3c`` -> `200 OK`
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: routing-override 9f3c removed. Traffic should be back to normal routing within 60s.
Sam: Support notified customers (email + in-app). Logged impact and actions in the status page thread.
Nora: Thanks team. I'll open a follow-up incident doc with timelines, root cause (redis network flapping), and recommendations: add cross-region KV failover and reduce routing failover TTL to 5m.
Jordan: I'll stay on the bridge 10 more minutes then drop. Good handoff.
Jordan: (30m) 21:35Z — dropping off bridge, no further action needed unless we see regression.
Nora: Closing incident channel — will convert to postmortem doc. If anything reappears, reopen INC-2026-0412. :white_check_mark:
